chapter_name: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
learning_objective: 🎯 Enter the incredible world of Carbon! Master IUPAC naming, understand how electrons shift in molecules (electronic effects), and learn how to purify organic compounds.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Carbon is unique because of its tetravalency (forms 4 bonds) and catenation (ability to form long chains and rings with itself). This is why there are millions of organic compounds!

The universal grammar for naming compounds. Follow the rules: 1. Find the longest carbon chain (Root word). 2. Identify the Primary suffix (ane, ene, yne). 3. Identify and number the Functional Group to give it the lowest possible locant number.

Compounds that have the exact same chemical formula but different structural arrangements. They can be Structural (chain, position, functional group) or Stereoisomers (different spatial arrangements in 3D).

How electrons move within a carbon chain! The Inductive Effect (I-effect) is the permanent pulling of sigma electrons by an electronegative atom. Resonance is the shifting of pi electrons across the molecule, heavily stabilizing it.
In organic reactions, molecules attack each other. Electrophiles are electron-poor (love negative charge, like $H^+$). Nucleophiles are electron-rich (love positive nucleus, like $OH^-$).

fun_activity.title: 🍇 3D Carbon Building
fun_activity.instructions: Take a handful of grapes and some toothpicks. Connect 4 toothpicks to a single grape as far apart as possible. You just built a 'Tetrahedral' Carbon atom ($sp^3$ hybridized) with bond angles of $109.5^\circ$!

exam_tips: 📌 Master the stability order of reaction intermediates! Carbocations and Free Radicals are most stable when Tertiary ($3^\circ > 2^\circ > 1^\circ$). Carbanions are the exact opposite ($1^\circ > 2^\circ > 3^\circ$).
📌 Remember the priority order for functional groups in IUPAC naming: Carboxylic acids > Sulfonic acids > Esters > Amides > Nitriles > Aldehydes > Ketones > Alcohols > Amines.
📌 Dumas method and Kjeldahl's method formulas for estimating Nitrogen percentage are very common in numericals.
quick_recap: ⭐ The Inductive effect operates through sigma bonds and gets drastically weaker as distance increases.
⭐ Resonance (Mesomeric effect) only operates through pi bonds and unshared pairs of electrons.
⭐ Distillation separates liquids based on their boiling points, while Chromatography separates mixtures based on differing affinities for stationary and mobile phases.
